business_meaning: Unique identifier for a ShopFast order.
allowed_values_or_range: 700001–705200 in the supplied data; unique and non-null after staging.

business_meaning: Account ID of the customer who placed the order.
allowed_values_or_range: 10001–20962 in data; values repeat across orders; non-null.

business_meaning: Calendar date the order was placed.
Current lifecycle state of the order; canceled normalized to cancelled.
allowed_values_or_range: pending, shipped, delivered, returned, cancelled (5 values); non-null.

business_meaning: Channel through which the order was placed.
Two-letter destination country code recorded for the order.
allowed_values_or_range: BE, DE, ES, FR; non-null in supplied rows.

business_meaning: Order total in euros, including VAT, as recorded by the order system.
unit_or_format: EUROS (EUR), exactly two decimals; NOT cents.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed -€49.90 to €1,400.79; negatives exist in supplied data.

business_meaning: Unique identifier assigned to a payment event.
Order identifier associated with the payment event.
Calendar date on which the payment event was recorded.
Payment instrument or provider method used.
Amount of this captured/refunded payment event.
unit_or_format: EUROS (EUR), two decimals; NOT cents. Currency field is EUR.

business_meaning: ISO 4217 currency code for the payment event.
allowed_values_or_range: EUR only in supplied data; non-null.

business_meaning: Last four digits of card when supplied by provider; missing for many non-card payments.
unit_or_format: Four numeric characters; retain as text (leading zeroes possible).
allowed_values_or_range: 4-digit strings when present; 1,953 nulls of 4,902 rows.
